name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v3332: HEART: a bank-time refusal with no user-facing surface; the bible.html change is the version stamp alone, and its watcher is the gate test_version_not_banked_into_graded_tree. The second eye read v3331 and found that MY FIX FOR A FALSE POSITIVE HAD CREATED FALSE NEGATIVES, which is the dangerous direction here. v3331 ALLOW-LISTED the interpreters that may run the pre-push hook, so any wrapper it had not thought of fell through to not-running. MEASURED on 10 hand-built command lines: 5 were wrong and every one was a false negative. nohup, env FOO=1, stdbuf -o0, a repository path containing a space, and git -c key=value push, whose push token sits outside the fixed toks 1 to 3 window the code scanned. A false negative says the tree is FREE while a gate is grading it, which banks a version mid-run and is the precise failure this module was written to prevent, reintroduced by the fix for its opposite. An allow-list fails OPEN on the unknown; a deny-list fails CLOSED. The list is now the READERS, a small enumerable set of editors and pagers, and anything else naming the hook counts as running it. The git push scan walks every token instead of a window. Both tests run on the RAW command line rather than on split tokens, because tokenising is what broke on a path with a space. Re-measured after the fix: 11 of 11 correct, including three negative fixtures that must never block a bump, and a free tree still answers free so this is not an off switch. 5 red-proofs PROVEN. A sixth was REMOVED as superseded, its anchor being a line this fix replaced.
